content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You don't have to wait for Stripe to 'approve' your account, or for PayPal to 'verify' your identity. You can deploy a fully functional digital commerce stack today, using free and open-source tools that live outside the control of any single company or government. The first step is to sign up for a Cloudflare account, which will become the backbone of your infrastructure. This will give you access to Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and R2, all of which are crucial components of the stack. You can also link your Supabase account, which will handle order storage, and your Google Drive, which will deliver files to customers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack consists of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and Google Drive. Each component plays a specific role in the overall infrastructure. GitHub Pages hosts your website, while Cloudflare Pages handles the payment processing. Cloudflare Workers provides the backend logic for your store, and Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, allows customers to pay with over 300 different cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Google Drive delivers files to customers, eliminating the need for a traditional payment gateway like Stripe or PayPal.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You don't need to worry about setting up a Stripe account or obtaining a PayPal business account. In fact, you can completely ignore these traditional payment gateways and their associated fees. Your focus should be on deploying the sovereign digital commerce stack, which will give you the freedom to accept payments from anywhere in the world, without relying on a single company or government. This means you can sell ebooks, courses, or software to anyone, anywhere, without the need for expensive intermediaries or crippling fees.
Deploying a digital commerce stack in West Africa or other regions with restricted access to traditional payment gateways is easier than you think.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once you have deployed the minimum viable stack, you can start selling your digital products. The first step is to add a payment button to your website, which will connect to NOWPayments. When a customer makes a payment, the transaction will be verified on-chain, and the order will be stored in Supabase. You can then deliver the file to the customer using Google Drive. This entire process happens automatically, without the need for manual intervention or expensive intermediaries.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, you should focus on deploying the sovereign digital commerce stack. This means signing up for Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and linking your Google Drive account. You should also create a new GitHub Pages site, which will host your website. Once you have everything set up, you can start selling your digital products and receiving payments from anywhere in the world.
